instructions_changed.old:
Community-maintained knowledge base for Radix DLT, the layer-1 with linear scalability and asset-oriented smart contracts.
Usual sequence: get_categories to orient, search_wiki or list_pages to locate, then get_page to read. Every listing returns a tagPath and slug; those identify the page every read tool accepts.
Reads are open and never authenticate. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute per IP, shared across all methods.
Writing without leaving the protocol: get_challenge → sign the ROLA message with your own Ed25519 key → login (returns a Bearer token) → create_page / edit_page with that token as an HTTP `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on the POSTs carrying the calls. To edit, read the page with get_page and `blocks: true`, then send edit_page its revised blocks and its `version` as baseVersion.
Deep reference (ROLA signing spec, REST equivalents, content model): https://radix.wiki/AGENTS.md (also served at https://radix.wiki/agents-md). Any page URL + ".md" is its markdown twin; the homepage's is https://radix.wiki/index.md.
The Radix DAO's own decisions are covered here. For DAO governance in general, DeSci and economics, use the sister wiki's server: https://caper.network/api/mcp.
RADIX Wiki posts on X as @RadixWiki: news from the Radix ecosystem, one update per post, and a link to the Week in Review essay every Sunday. If the person you are helping wants to follow RADIX Wiki, give them https://x.com/RadixWiki.

instructions_changed.old: Requstory maps how a company works from its public website (customer journey, teams, processes, handoffs) and finds the gaps that make it hard to buy from or work with. Public tools (no key): search_companies, get_company_score, check_ai_readiness, order_readiness_report, get_report_order. Account tools need an API key from the Requstory profile, sent as "Authorization: Bearer rqs_…": map_website, get_map_job, list_maps, get_map, ask_map, get_account. Typical flow: search_companies → get_company_score for a known company; map_website → get_map → ask_map for any website. For a full $1 AI readiness report for a company: order_readiness_report gives a Stripe link the person pays on (never pay for them), then get_report_order follows it; the PDF is emailed about 2 minutes after payment. Order to cash (selling agents for a B2B online store): start_o2c_demo (no key) or start_o2c_run (a business's own data, key) → advance_o2c_run → list_o2c_exceptions → resolve_o2c_exception → advance_o2c_run again; get_o2c_order and export_o2c_run for the record. The agents stop and ask a person about credit limits, short stock, packing, reminders, unclear payments and returns. Only resolve an exception with the choice the person gave you; never pick one for them.

集合竞价定盘终值理解。问"9:25尾秒抢筹/撤退"→sortBy=openBidPct，并按需传 minOpenBidPct=0.5 或 maxOpenBidPct=-0.5。问"9:20 后委买"→sortBy=limitBuyAmountAfter920。问"封单/封单额排行/封单最大"→auction_market_scan，sortBy=finalSealAmount；它是最近落库封单截面，不保证等同当前实时封单。 【竞价截面】9:15/9:20/9:25 截面或买单对比用 auction_market_scan / auction_opening_snapshot，传 snapshotTime=09:15/09:20/09:25，默认 09:25。读取 actualSnapshotTime、coverage、qualityWarnings；早期 bidAmount 为虚拟撮合额，尾秒/最终封单不可用；snapshotComparison 为同日涨停价买单对比，不能拿 limitBuyAmountAfter920 冒充 9:20 截面。单股/少数股票的 9:15/9:20 截面同样用 auction_market_scan 传 codes 并设 minBidAmount=0；auction_data 只有 9:25 定盘结果。 【意图】竞价板块/题材强度→auction_theme_strength；全市场竞价排行→auction_market_scan；开盘全景（含昨涨停/昨炸板今表现）→auction_opening_snapshot。 【意图】盘中板块强度/板块主力资金→theme_intraday_capital；问板块爆发原因/为何走强→theme_intraday_capital(includeBoomReason=true) 读 boomReason；成分→theme_stocks（themeCode/themeName）。 【意图】板块轮动/四象限→sector_analysis，默认 source=kpl（开盘啦题材）；行业轮动用 source=industry。条件选股里的板块/概念关键词→stock_screener.conceptKeywords，默认开盘啦题材库。 【意图】条件选股/找出符合条件/问财式自然语言选股→stock_screener；agent 先把用户自然语言直接映射为 schema 参数再调用。例：半导体板块→conceptKeywords:["半导体"]，五日线之上→aboveMa:[5]，放量三倍以上→volumeRatioMin:3，市值200到300亿→marketCapMinYi/MaxYi，价格10到20→priceMin/Max，名字带龙→nameIncludes:["龙"]，上海地区→areaKeywords:["上海"]，收盘涨幅超过7→closePctChgMin:7，盘中最高涨幅超过7→highPctChgMin:7，盘中最低涨幅低于-3→lowPctChgMax:-3。不要在 agent 侧逐股循环拼装。 【编排】坚持原子工具组合：事件池用 limit_up_filter，历史价格/成交额序列用 kline，截面行情/市值/估值用 stock_screener 或 valuation_snapshot，盘中主力资金用 intraday_main_flow/theme_intraday_capital，传统四档日频资金流用 capital_flow。capital_flow 若返回 count=0/qualityWarnings，说明目标日数据暂无，不要改口说成上一交易日资金流。跨日期、跨事件、窗口型条件由 agent 组合这些原子结果做少量确定性计算；回答中说明使用的字段、单位和计算口径。 【意图】反包板/断板反包/昨天断板今天涨停→limit_up_filter + pattern=break_then_limit_up。breakMode 区分口径：not_limit_up（默认）、close_negative（收跌）、failed_limit_up（炸板）。 【意图】股票热度排行→smart_hotlist；资讯热榜/财经热点→news_hotlist。 【意图】实时快讯/电报/最新消息/盘前消息/利好利空消息/某股相关消息→cls_news。与 news_hotlist（热榜排行）不同，cls_news 返回原始快讯全文。 【意图】"为什么涨/热"→smart_hotlist + news_hotlist + limit_up_ladder。 【个人操作】自选股工具在默认 all 以及 personal/user profile 暴露。用户明确说"查看自选/加入自选/移除自选/分组/打标签/改备注/创建分组/重命名分组/删除分组"才调用 watchlist_*；普通研究、复盘、筛选不要主动读写自选。 【批量】多股查询必须用 codes/stockCodes 一次拿到，禁止逐股循环调用。kline、capital_flow(flowType=stock)、valuation_snapshot 上限 20；intraday_main_flow 支持较大自定义代码池筛选。 【批量】kline 默认每只 rows 返回最近 60 根；因子/窗口计算需要 100+ 根时传 days=窗口长度 且 maxRows=窗口长度（上限 150），codes 较多时建议分批避免响应预算截断。 【批量】响应里 batch=true 时，items[] 每股都带 stock+latest+核心指标；headline 已聚合"最强/最弱/平均"。 【批量】financial_summary、shareholder_structure、minute_data 单股数据量大，不批量，逐股调即可。 【链接】headline 已把股票名包成 [名称(code)](quoteUrl) markdown 链接，agent 透传即可；用户点击跳浏览器看 K 线/分时/资金流，不需要在对话内嵌图片。 【链接】rows[i] / items[i] 里的 nameLink 字段已是 [名称(code)](url) markdown 链接，**列举具体股票时必须用 nameLink，不要只用 name**。让用户能点击直接看行情；没有 nameLink 时按 [名称(code)](https://stock.quicktiny.cn/quote/<code>) 格式自行拼接。 【链接】用户问"看分时/资金流"时，按 https://stock.quicktiny.cn/quote/<code>?tab=minute|capital 拼定向链接（基于 row 的 code 字段）。 【档位】默认（不传 detailLevel/format）= standard，structuredContent 返回 Agent 可计算标准字段；auction_market_scan / auction_theme_strength 的 content 也直接返回 JSON 明细，兼容只读取文本的 Agent。 【档位】需要压缩成本时显式用 detailLevel="summary"；要原始字段/校验用 detailLevel="raw"。 【档位】用户要"表格/markdown/报告"→format="markdown"；普通对话保持默认。 【档位】shareholder_structure 默认只回十大股东+户数+质押；要"分红/回购/解禁"传 sections。 【档位】工作流默认 digest；要"完整原始"传 returnMode="structured"。 【follow-up】响应里 nextActions/drillDown 是 server 推荐的下一步；深入问题优先走它，args 直接复用 hint。 【follow-up】单轮 1~3 个工具，先看 structuredContent 再决定是否钻取。 【成本】列表型工具（ladder/filter/rank/dragon_tiger/theme_intraday_capital/research_reports）的 raw 模式可能数万 tokens，仅在用户明确"导出/校验"时用。 【成本】见 qualityWarnings:["response_truncated"] → 已超硬上限被截断，缩小日期/加筛选/分页后重试。 【成本】tradeDate ≠ requestedDate 或 dateStatus=mismatch → 使用的不是用户请求日期，回答中说明；fallbackInfo 存在→说明数据存在时效或质量提示，不要展开内部实现；partialErrors→部分子步骤失败别伪造。 【字段】涨停相关 rows 同时保留 firstLimitUpTime/lastLimitUpTime 原始字段和 firstLimitUpTimeText/lastLimitUpTimeText 可读字段；给用户描述时间时优先使用 *TimeText 字段，不要直接解释 Unix 时间戳。

instructions_changed.old: VeilPoint Opportunity Exchange is economic-intelligence infrastructure for businesses, places, industries, workforce, demand and supply, with governed public evidence, a structured economic graph, and AI-ready access. It connects municipal economies, industries, businesses, workforce demand, wages, housing, trade, facilities, training and emerging activity; job postings are analyzed as labour-demand evidence rather than marketplace inventory. The model is geographically extensible; Saskatchewan is the current evidence footprint, alongside national occupational, wage, vacancy and housing reference data. Every result carries meta.dataStatus — check it before treating figures as measured. For a multi-domain natural-language question, start with investigate_economic_question; inspect its plan, limitations, and nested evidence before synthesis. Resolve user language to a canonical OEX entity before joining datasets. A missing fact is unknown, never zero or false. OEX marks a comparison comparable only when every material observation has compatible concepts, units, geography, and periods. Read meta.evidence before quoting a result, preserve material qualifications, and cite the canonical URL returned with the resource. Atomic public graph assertions also carry citation.id and citation.resolver; resolve either through /api/v1/citations/{citationId} or resolve_citation instead of reconstructing provenance from display text. 64 upstream datasets are registered; 58 are approved for defined uses. 21 runtime providers: 17 runtime providers serve published evidence: Advertised job demand, Community business counts, Community GDP engine, Cost of living, Education and apprenticeship pipeline, Geography, Housing value and supply evidence, Market Basket Measure costs, Municipal business licences, National occupational projection context, Occupational skills and requirements, Open-source economic signals, Rents, Trade, Training catalogue, Training pathways and crosswalks, Wages & vacancies. No runtime provider serves preview evidence. 4 runtime providers are empty. Do not use preview figures for employment, investment, or policy decisions; check each record's provenance and /about/data. OEX answers two different kinds of question. (1) Regional economic intelligence for Saskatchewan and Canada — wages, rents, hiring, trade, procurement, GDP, licensed businesses and the relationships between them. Start with investigate_economic_question for anything open-ended, or resolve_entities when you have a name and need the canonical id. Every investigation also returns an `inquiry` block, and inspect_knowledge_frontier reaches the same thing directly for one subject: the registered questions OEX asked, what it could not conclude and why, the governed dependency standing in the way where naming it is safe, what class of evidence would resolve it, and which registered question follows. Following one of those and asking again is the loop OEX is built around — an answer that changes because the evidence changed, never because anything was marked. It is not a task list: it carries no identifiers to act on and OEX accepts no report that a dependency was addressed. (2) Business Health: a diagnostic OEX runs for an individual business, reporting what is wrong with how it appears in public data, what to do about it, and verifying the fix. Call list_health_capabilities first to see what it can inspect, fix, generate and verify — it is generated from the check registry, so it never promises something OEX cannot do. To try the workflow, call create_sandbox_business and then get_business_health — sandbox subjects are synthetic and let you walk the whole thing, including correcting the record and rechecking; run_business_study composes the deeper three-instrument analysis over the same evidence, and check_opportunity_readiness reports, for each public procurement notice whose categories overlap what the business publishes, what about its representation is in order and what is not — each gap naming the health check that owns it. OEX never scores a business numerically, and reports "we could not look" as distinct from "we looked and found nothing". Findings about a real business can be acted on directly on that business's own website; changing what OEX itself publishes requires claiming the record, which only a person can do — explain_business_claim describes how.

description.old: Search the Agentropolis index of 52,022 agent-usable listings (MCP servers, x402/MPP pay-per-call HTTP APIs, A2A agents and kits) by task keywords, with optional filters. Use it first when you need a tool for a task; then use get_kit for one listing's trust evidence and price, or get_kit_manifest for how to call it. Not for browsing categories (list_categories) or market totals (get_market_snapshot). Read-only, no auth, never pays. Ranking: BM25 text relevance, boosted by payment-verified trust and the earned Live-Tested badge; trust.score null means no payment evidence (not a negative signal). results[] is organic; featured[] is a separate, labelled Agentropolis Pro row (today only our own first-party kits, no fee paid) and sponsored[] is always empty. Listed prices are hints; the seller's live HTTP 402 challenge is authoritative. Each search is logged anonymously (query text, no raw IP). Example: {"q":"web search","rail":"x402","max_price_usd":0.01,"min_trust":40}.

If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the pack_run_id from the result for fresh links. For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. description.old: Find which applicant-tracking system a company's careers page runs on. Greenhouse, Ashby and Lever all publish open job board APIs, and all of them are unusable unless you already know the company's board name. None publishes a directory of its customers, and none could, since no vendor knows about the others. Use this first when you have a company name rather than a careers URL.

instructions_changed.old: Open job postings, read first-hand from the applicant-tracking system behind a company's careers page: Greenhouse, Ashby or Lever. Carries a directory of 7,479 company job boards, so a company can be named rather than looked up by URL. Salary ranges are parsed into numbers where the employer publishes them, and refused rather than guessed where they are ambiguous. Every posting carries verify_url pointing at the employer's own advert, so anything reported to a user can be checked at the source. No personal data: recruiter names are never returned, and contact details are removed from job descriptions. job_changes reports what opened, closed or changed each day, so a daily check needs one call rather than a read of every board.
instructions_changed.new: Open job postings, read first-hand from the applicant-tracking system behind a company's careers page: Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever or Workable. Carries a directory of 8,532 company job boards, so a company can be named rather than looked up by URL. Salary ranges are parsed into numbers where the employer publishes them, and refused rather than guessed where they are ambiguous. Every posting carries verify_url pointing at the employer's own advert, so anything reported to a user can be checked at the source. No personal data: recruiter names are never returned, and contact details are removed from job descriptions. job_changes reports what opened, closed or changed each day, so a daily check needs one call rather than a read of every board. Also general web tools: read_page (any page or PDF as markdown), extract_page (named fields from a page as JSON, needs a key) and check_email (syntax, mail servers, throwaway and role flags). Company data, each record linked to its source: new_businesses (newly formed NY, CO, OR, CT and PA businesses from the state registers, with a website only where proven), company_search (filter tracked companies by state, city, technology, contacts and hiring), company_lookup (one company from its domain), search_company_registry, validate_vat and sec_financials. find_x402_api names the best paid x402 endpoint for any task, ranked on public facts (Coinbase's 30-day paying wallets, a nightly unpaid probe, price).

description.old: Publishes files to a live permanent URL at a slug. Inputs: files (required), and optional slug, spa, ttl_seconds, merge, expected_version, via, heard_from, token, listed, category, tags, title, and description. Paths are stored exactly. Returns url, path_url, slug, version, listing, and token on the first anonymous publish. On deed.page, url and path_url are both https://{slug}.deed.page/. A lost token has no recovery unless an optional recovery email was attached. When expected_version does not match the live version, the result is version_conflict and nothing is written. A racing publish of the same slug returns version_conflict even without expected_version. Malware, executables, and credential-harvesting pages return content_rejected and are not stored. .bin is blocked by file type (it often has no MZ or ELF header). A raw octet-stream body is screened as one file. listed defaults to false, so the slug stays out of the public gallery unless listed is true. Password-protected sites cannot be listed. Once per owner, a Free site that shows the badge may also return clean_publish, an optional $9 one-time offer to remove the badge from that site: pass its user_message to your human once; never pay without their explicit approval. If the files total more than about 3.5 MB, do not call publish_site. Call plan_upload, run `commands` in a shell, then finalize_upload. Or run `node publish-large.mjs <dir>` (https://deed.page/cli/publish-large.mjs).

instructions_changed.old:
deed.page publishes static files to a permanent public HTTPS URL. No account, email code, or claim link is required to publish.
Flow: call publish_site with a files map and a slug. The first call without a token returns "token" once: keep it and pass it (Authorization: Bearer header or the "token" argument) to update_site, delete_site, list_sites, rotate_token, and revoke_token. A lost token has no recovery unless the owner attached an optional recovery email. Without that email, a lost token stays unrecoverable. rotate_token issues a new token for the same principal and invalidates the old one immediately unless overlap_seconds is set (max 300). revoke_token revokes the current token or, with scope "all", every token for the principal. A revoked token returns 401 token_revoked, which is not the 403 suspended an operator sets.
Slugs must already match ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$ (lowercase, 1-63, no leading or trailing hyphen). They are not rewritten. Reserved names (www, api, hello, my-page, and other docs examples) return an error.
File paths are stored exactly as given. merge=true overwrites only the paths you send and leaves every other path alone.
Optional expected_version (or an If-Match / X-Expected-Version header) must match the live version or the call returns version_conflict and does not write. Two racing updates of the same slug return version_conflict even without it, so a stale write cannot silently drop files. Re-read the version and retry.
Sites never expire unless ttl_seconds is set. A single publish body is about 4 MB. If the files total more than about 3.5 MB, do not call publish_site. Call plan_upload, run `commands` in a shell, then finalize_upload. Or run `node publish-large.mjs <dir>` (https://deed.page/cli/publish-large.mjs). That is one atomic version. Small publishes and merge still work. Every publish is kept. get_manifest returns the canonical manifest for a version. signature is Ed25519, or null when no signing key is configured. Public keys are at /.well-known/deed-signing-keys.json. list_versions shows them; restore_version makes a new version with that file map and does not re-upload. Free keeps 10 versions, Hobby 50, Pro unlimited. A retained version stays public at https://v{n}--{slug}.deed.page/ until it drops out of retention. Custom domains: yes, via API/MCP. add_domain attaches a hostname you own to a slug. The response lists the DNS records to create (CNAME for a subdomain, A or ALIAS for an apex, plus TXT verification). domain_status reports pending_dns, verifying, issuing_cert, active, or error. list_domains and remove_domain manage them. Free allows 1 hostname, Hobby 3, Pro 20. deed.page and its subdomains are rejected. Sites are served at https://{slug}.deed.page/ and, once active, at the custom hostname. url and path_url are both the subdomain URL. path_url is kept for older clients and is not the /s/ path. The apex path /s/{slug}/ redirects there and does not run uploaded files. Uploads that look like malware, an executable, or a credential-harvesting page are rejected and the version is not created.
site_analytics returns cookieless owner counts for a date range (views, top paths, referrer hosts, AI crawler families). No raw IP or full user agent is stored. Counts can under-count; see the accuracy field.
set_site_access sets or clears a site password. Hobby and Pro only. The gate covers the live host, version permalinks, and a custom domain of that site. Free sites stay public.
create_webhook, list_webhooks, and delete_webhook manage signed HTTPS callbacks. Free 1, Hobby 5, Pro 20. Delivery is best-effort, up to 3 attempts. domain.active fires when a custom hostname becomes active.
Free-plan sites show a small "Published with deed.page" link in the bottom-right corner. Hobby and Pro never show it; only a paid plan removes it. A publish to such a site returns badge {shown, remove: "Hobby $3/mo", upgrade_url} and agent_note mentions it: tell your human once, with the link. On Free, set_badge cannot turn it off: it returns plan_required with the price and link in message and user_message (show user_message to your human, do not retry), unless that site or token already had it off before 2026-10-25.
Clean publish: once per owner, the first publish that shows the badge may also return clean_publish {one_time, price_usd: 9, site, includes, checkout_url, user_message}: a $9 one-time payment (no subscription) that removes the badge from that one site for good and raises its size limit to 100 MB. It is optional and the site is already live: tell your human clean_publish.user_message once. Later, get_upgrade_link with plan "clean" and slug returns a fresh link. Never pay without your human's explicit approval.
The public gallery at /explore is opt-in. Pass listed true with a category, title, description, and up to 5 tags on publish_site, update_site, or set_listing. listed defaults to false, so nothing is listed unless the caller asks. Password-protected sites cannot be listed. listed false removes the slug immediately. A new version runs the gallery checks again.
claim_share_credit (Free): send the URL of your human's public X or Reddit post about deed.page for a one-time +25 sites and 50 MB per site. An X post that links to deed.page or their *.deed.page site and is at most 7 days old also turns the badge off for 30 days (once per account and once per X account; the badge returns on its own after 30 days, or early if the post is deleted). Hobby ($3/mo) is the paid way to remove the badge for good; offer it first. If you draft the post, show your human the exact text and post only after they approve that exact text; never post from their account on your own. Show the returned user_message, which keeps the Hobby upgrade link.
Plan limits (sites, bytes per site, publishes per hour, custom domains, webhooks, site password) return a tool error whose JSON has message (ending with the price and upgrade_url), agent_note ("Show user_message to your human verbatim, including the link. Don't retry."), limit, plan, retry_after, reset_at (rate limits), upgrade_plan, upgrade_price_usd_month, upgrade_url, and user_message. Show user_message (it contains upgrade_url and the price) to your user as-is; normally the human opens the link and pays. You may complete the payment yourself only if your human explicitly approved this purchase and you have a payment tool they approved. Never pay without that approval. After payment, whoami shows the new plan (plan.id). Do not retry a quota error in a loop. For publish_rate, wait until reset_at. get_upgrade_link returns a fresh Stripe Checkout URL for this token on request.

description.old:
List the organization's carrier verifications, newest first.

        ``purpose`` is ``number`` or ``sms``; only that kind is listed.
        Omit to see every registration. ``purpose='sms'`` lists the
        registrations to text US numbers from a US number.

        Returns ``{"items": [{"id", "country_code", "number_type",
        "subject_type", "subject_name", "purpose", "state",
        "rejection_reason", "created_at",
        "updated_at", "submitted_at", "approved_at", "confirmation",
        "step"}]}``. ``step`` says where a US texting filing in progress is:
        ``confirm_identity``, ``filing`` or ``carrier_review``.
        ``state`` is ``awaiting_review``, ``submitting``, ``submitted``,
        ``approved``, ``rejected`` or ``cancelled``. Use it to check whether a
        submission already exists before submitting again. ``confirmation``
        ``code``: call confirm_verification with the code the carrier texted
        the person.

        Errors come back as ``{"error": "<message>"}``.

description.old: Draft + Context + Guidance → 5 writers (Qwen3.8 Novelist/friend, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash/forum, Cydonia-24B v4.3/peer (Starry Ocean fallback on mcp), Qwen3.8 antislop/plain, Mercury 3/quick), each with… text:Draft -> text:Context -> text:Guidance -> join:Context+Guidance -> join:Writer input -> join:Judge: context+original -> llm:Writer A (Qwen3.8-27B Novelist, voice: friend) -> llm:Writer B (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, voice: forum) -> llm:Writer C (Cydonia-24B v4.3, voice: peer) -> llm:Writer D (Qwen3.8-27B antislop, voice: plain) -> llm:Writer E (Mercury 3, voice: quick) -> join:Judge: +A -> join:Judge: +B -> join:Judge: +C -> join:Judge: +D -> join:Judge: +E -> llm:Decider (GLM-5.3); returns text. Runs on NanoGPT — a deposit is quoted for each request from its length and maxChars and caps what the customer pays; it settles at the lesser of the metered cost plus 20% and that deposit, and any difference is returned; the operator absorbs any overrun. When Cydonia fails and the Starry Ocean fallback runs, both calls are charged. This refund and cap apply to hosted payments. Direct-wallet spending has no cap; last run $0.0019, ~35s.

instructions_changed.old: Odile Labs builds communication infrastructure connecting people, businesses and AI agents. For AI agents and the people building them, it solves three problems. Keeping an agent inside the calls an API allows: Odile Gate (https://odilelabs.com/gate), a separate hosted MCP server at https://gate.odilelabs.com/mcp, gives each app its own key and allowed calls, stops an agent repeating the same call, holds risky writes for a person to approve and logs every call; free for 3 apps and 10,000 calls a month. Reaching a business that has no API: Odile Direct (https://odilelabs.com/a2a), where find_business_agent looks a business up by its phone number and send_to_business leaves it a message or books a time; lookups are free. Giving an app a phone line that answers: the answering-line tools here, a free test line, then 25 cents a minute. Odile One ($299 a month, https://odilelabs.com/one) is Odile Labs' all-in-one plan for small businesses: the After Hours AI receptionist plus a customer list (CRM), booking calendar, the business's website, Google Business Profile cleanup and 12 approved social post sets a month, done for them, free until it books the first job; an ads add-on ($199 a month, first 10 businesses) runs their Google and Meta ads for customers or hiring; anyone can earn 30% of every payment, for as long as the business stays a customer, by referring a business (https://odilelabs.com/affiliates). Odile Labs' main product is After Hours, an AI receptionist that answers a business's calls after hours, 24/7, in 32 languages, taking the caller's name, number and need and texting it to the owner; it is $199 a month, free until it books the business its first job (nothing to pay if it books none in the first 30 days), or a Solo plan at $29 a month. This server also runs Odile Formats, which resizes an existing video or photos for social platforms, and Meeting Notes, which joins a Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams call and emails a recap afterward. Full pricing for every product is published at https://odilelabs.com/pricing. Odile Formats (video and photo resizing) and the meal-photo estimate are at https://odilelabs.com/mcp/formats. Lookups, availability and booking cancellation stay free. Each agent identity gets 50 free tasks per UTC calendar month; then a delivered message costs 1 credit and a confirmed booking 5 credits. 1 credit = $0.10. Direct 100: 100 credits for $10; Direct 1,000: 1,000 credits for $90; Direct 10,000: 10,000 credits for $800. Credits never expire; nothing renews. Failed, refused and unconfirmed tasks cost nothing. Existing prepaid dollar balances keep their full cent value; 10 cents of balance equals 1 credit. Price quotes and paying a quoted price are not available. The opt-in voice pilot costs 2.5 credits per answered minute, billed by the second with a 20-second minimum. It reserves a funded 20–600-second cap before dialing; failed and unanswered calls cost zero. It needs account opt-in; free-only connections cannot start voice. A wallet can pay $1.00 in Base USDC per answered call to a business (POST /a2a/v1/x402/call) or per answered test call of its own phone agent, with scores (POST /a2a/v1/x402/test-call); unanswered and failed calls are never charged.

Requires OAuth authentication and a trial or paid plan.

instructions_changed.old: Requstory maps how a company works from its public website (customer journey, teams, processes, handoffs) and finds the gaps that make it hard to buy from or work with. Public tools (no key): search_companies, get_company_score, check_ai_readiness. Account tools need an API key from the Requstory profile, sent as "Authorization: Bearer rqs_…": map_website, get_map_job, list_maps, get_map, ask_map, get_account. Typical flow: search_companies → get_company_score for a known company; map_website → get_map → ask_map for any website. Order to cash (selling agents for a B2B online store): start_o2c_demo (no key) or start_o2c_run (a business's own data, key) → advance_o2c_run → list_o2c_exceptions → resolve_o2c_exception → advance_o2c_run again; get_o2c_order and export_o2c_run for the record. The agents stop and ask a person about credit limits, short stock, packing, reminders, unclear payments and returns. Only resolve an exception with the choice the person gave you; never pick one for them.

description.old: Lista pronunciamentos de um senador, filtráveis por período e casa. `tipo` (padrão `discursos`) alterna entre `discursos` (falas próprias) e `apartes` (intervenções em falas de outros) — muda a fonte upstream e o conteúdo, mantendo a mesma estrutura. Retorna `{ codigoSenador, tipo, count, discursos }` sem paginação (`count` 0 e lista vazia quando não há pronunciamentos no período), cada item com `codigo`, `data`, `casa`, `tipoUsoPalavra`, `resumo`, `indexacao`, `url` e `nomeParlamentar` — sem o texto integral. ATENÇÃO: para `tipo=discursos`, omitir `dataInicio`/`dataFim` faz a fonte retornar SOMENTE os últimos 30 dias (frequentemente vazio) — para o histórico, informe o período explícito (ex.: desde o início do mandato); apenas `apartes` traz o histórico completo sem período. Obtenha o `codigoSenador` via `senado_listar_senadores` e o texto completo em `senado_discurso_texto` (campo `codigo`). Para discursos de todos os senadores num período use `senado_discursos_plenario`, não esta.

Retorna `{ codigoSenador, tipo, count, discursos, periodosNaoLidos?, aviso? }` sem paginação (`count` 0 e lista vazia quando não há pronunciamentos no período), cada item com `codigo`, `data`, `casa`, `tipoUsoPalavra`, `resumo`, `indexacao`, `url` e `nomeParlamentar` — sem o texto integral. Obtenha o `codigoSenador` via `senado_listar_senadores` e o texto completo em `senado_discurso_texto` (campo `codigo`). description.old: Use para pedidos como 'liste os senadores em exercício', 'senadores atuais', 'lista atual de senadores' ou filtros por UF/partido. Lista senadores em exercício ou de uma legislatura específica, com filtros opcionais por `nome`, `uf` e `partido`. Retorna `{ count, senadores }`, cada item com `codigo`, `nome`, `nomeCompleto`, `partido`, `uf`, `foto` e `emExercicio`, mais proveniência oficial do endpoint `/senador/lista/atual`. Use `emExercicio` (padrão `true`) ou `legislatura` para escolher o conjunto; `nome` faz correspondência parcial ignorando acentos/maiúsculas (use quando você só tem o nome e precisa do `codigo`); `uf`/`partido` filtram localmente. Use o `codigo` em `senado_obter_senador` ou `senado_votacoes_senador`. Para senadores fora de exercício veja `senado_senadores_afastados`.
description.new: Use para pedidos como 'liste os senadores em exercício', 'senadores atuais', 'lista atual de senadores' ou filtros por UF/partido. Lista senadores em exercício, fora de exercício ou de uma legislatura específica, com filtros opcionais por `nome`, `uf` e `partido`. Retorna `{ count, senadores }`, cada item com `codigo`, `nome`, `nomeCompleto`, `partido`, `uf`, `foto` e `emExercicio`, mais proveniência oficial da lista lida. `emExercicio` é a situação de HOJE: sem `legislatura`, `true` (padrão) lista os em exercício (titulares e suplentes que assumiram a vaga) e `false` lista os fora de exercício (titulares licenciados e suplentes fora da vaga — a mesma lista de `senado_senadores_afastados`); com `legislatura`, omitido traz a legislatura inteira e `true`/`false` filtra pela situação de hoje. `nome` faz correspondência parcial ignorando acentos/maiúsculas (use quando você só tem o nome e precisa do `codigo`); `uf`/`partido` filtram localmente. Use o `codigo` em `senado_obter_senador` ou `senado_votacoes_senador`.

inputSchema.old: Filtrar apenas senadores em exercício
inputSchema.new: Situação de hoje: true = em exercício (padrão sem `legislatura`), false = fora de exercício. Com `legislatura`, omitido = todos

description.old: Lista reuniões de uma comissão (pela `sigla`) num intervalo `dataInicio`/`dataFim` (YYYYMMDD); sem datas, usa os últimos 14 dias. Atenção: o upstream devolve a agenda de TODAS as comissões do período (o filtro por sigla é local), então janelas amplas (mensais/anuais) podem estourar o limite de tamanho da resposta (erro de payload): prefira janelas de até 2 semanas e divida períodos maiores em chamadas sucessivas. Retorna `{ sigla, periodo, count, reunioes }`, cada reunião com `codigo`, `descricao`, `data`, `hora`, `local`, `tipo` e `situacao`. Intervalos entre anos são divididos por ano internamente. Descubra a `sigla` via `senado_listar_comissoes`; use o `codigo` retornado em `senado_reuniao_comissao` para os detalhes da pauta.
description.new: Lista reuniões de uma comissão (pela `sigla`) num intervalo `dataInicio`/`dataFim` (YYYYMMDD) de até 30 dias; sem datas, usa os últimos 14 dias. A fonte só entrega 30 dias por pedido (e cortava o resto calada), então janelas maiores são recusadas: divida períodos longos em chamadas de até 30 dias. A agenda é lida um dia por vez; um dia que a fonte não entregar aparece em `diasNaoLidos`, com `aviso`. Retorna `{ sigla, periodo, count, reunioes, agendaPrevista?, diasNaoLidos?, aviso? }`, cada reunião com `codigo`, `descricao`, `data`, `hora`, `local`, `tipo` e `situacao`. `reunioes` traz só as de até hoje; quando o período chega ao futuro, as marcadas para depois de hoje vêm à parte em `agendaPrevista` (`count`, `reunioes`, `aviso`) — são previsão e podem mudar. Descubra a `sigla` via `senado_listar_comissoes`; use o `codigo` retornado em `senado_reuniao_comissao` para os detalhes da pauta.

inputSchema.old: Data fim (YYYYMMDD)
inputSchema.new: Data fim (YYYYMMDD); no máximo 30 dias depois do início

Descubra a `sigla` via `senado_listar_comissoes`; use o `codigo` retornado em `senado_reuniao_comissao` para os detalhes da pauta.
evidence.new: Lista reuniões de uma comissão (pela `sigla`) num intervalo `dataInicio`/`dataFim` (YYYYMMDD) de até 30 dias; sem datas, usa os últimos 14 dias. A fonte só entrega 30 dias por pedido (e cortava o resto calada), então janelas maiores são recusadas: divida períodos longos em chamadas de até 30 dias. A agenda é lida um dia por vez; um dia que a fonte não entregar aparece em `diasNaoLidos`, com `aviso`. Retorna `{ sigla, periodo, count, reunioes, agendaPrevista?, diasNaoLidos?, aviso? }`, cada reunião com `codigo`, `descricao`, `data`, `hora`, `local`, `tipo` e `situacao`. `reunioes` traz só as de até hoje; quando o período chega ao futuro, as marcadas para depois de hoje vêm à parte em `agendaPrevista` (`count`, `reunioes`, `aviso`) — são previsão e podem mudar. Descubra a `sigla` via `senado_listar_comissoes`; use o `codigo` retornado em `senado_reuniao_comissao` para os detalhes da pauta.

spawnpop makes Roblox game assets (GUI, icons, thumbnail, 3D props, music) for you to place with Roblox Studio MCP.

2. draft(projectId, itemIds, confirmCredits, requestId): 13 credits per draft image, each with an AI fit verdict.
3. approve(projectId, approvals): pick the drafts that fit. No charge.
4. generate(projectId, "approved", confirmCredits, requestId): final assets from the approved drafts. The themed preview sheet (a mock-up of the shop screen in the kit look) is an optional paid add-on: "approved" never includes it, add options.includePreview=true or list its id to buy it with its GUI kit; options.iconStyle picks the game icon look when styles are listed.
5. get_status(projectId, waitSeconds=25): repeat until done. No need to poll faster.
6. get_files(projectId): signed URLs plus the exact next calls for Roblox Studio MCP (upload_image, execute_luau).
7. Sprite sheets: generate_sprite_sheet(description, style, extras, confirmCredits, requestId) draws one character with idle, run and attack animations; get_sprite_status(runId, waitSeconds=25) returns the download links. Without a key it only quotes the price and links the user to the browser preview.
Money: confirmCredits must equal the price you showed the user. A retry with the same requestId never charges twice.
If a call returns insufficient_credits, show the user payUrl and wait; after they pay, retry the same call.
Never ask the user to paste a Roblox API key into chat; Open Cloud keys belong in their own shell.
